summary: Fixed all 11 review findings with regression coverage. Web routes share the existing search logic using a caller-owned, encoded mode=ro connection, preserve legacy schemas, and expose safe index maintenance states. Loopback-only startup, strict Host/Origin checks, IPv6, health, masked malformed-request handling, URL-safe job links, method rejection and Ctrl+C cleanup are covered, including a real CLI-to-HTTP subprocess smoke test without API keys; CLI search initialization remains compatible. README documents W0 scope and health semantics.
